name: Animate Instrument
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target instrument touched
Duration 1 min./level

DESCRIPTION

You complete the spell and your instrument hovers next to you and keeps up your tune and maintains the effects of your bardic performance, assuming it is instrument-based. While the instrument is maintaining your bardic performance, you do not suffer any possibility of failure from being deaf nor does the performance end when you are killed, paralyzed, stunned or unconscious. The spell continues to use your rounds of bardic performance unless you use an action to change or end it. If you are killed, paralyzed, stunned or unconscious, you cannot stop or change the performance and the performance active before the condition will continue until the spell expires, you run out of bardic performance rounds, or you regain the ability to change the performance.
